text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo wanna run in the Satsuki 
Sho, I really do! I wanna run with Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Does Turbo really have no chance of 
winning~? Is it really, truly zero~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, Traineeer...
choice_data_list:
Our chances of winning... well, it's not 
like we don't have any!

text_block_list.text:
――It was the truth. The race with the 
shortest distance and the shortest final 
straight among the Classic Triple Crown is 
the Satsuki Sho.
Bracing myself, I decided to step inside.
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(Uwoah, what a huge crowd... So this is 
the Satsuki Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Someone's looking over here. 
That's...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's the President... Which means she 
isn't watching Turbo, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Well, just watch me!

Befitting a major race, Student Council 
President Symboli Rudolf and many other 
senior horse girls came to watch. For 
instance—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Show me—your own kind of freedom. It's 
precisely because nobody is watching that 
you can soar.

text_block_list.name: Competing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I feel something... on a destined 
level!

The one who instantly caught my eye was 
Mr. C.B., a horse girl who, like the 
Student Council President, had achieved 
the Triple Crown.

It seemed each Umamusume had found someone 
they felt destined to face. Meanwhile, 
Twin Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Destiny level??? What's that, does it 
taste good...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo doesn't feel anything. But if Turbo 
had to say something...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Trainer! Turbo's gonna do her 
destined best!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm counting on you guys!

text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo doesn't possess some special 
thing to guide her forward. And yet—

"That is precisely why her running is 
unlike anyone else's. Let us look forward 
to the showdown of a lifetime, where she 
burns with everything she has."
